{{Top|leg}}
A '''transfer tube''' was used on large [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to travel between multiple decks. It was similar to a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]], but passengers would be floated through the tubes using [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], but not cars. Lift tubes would bring passengers up and drop shafts would lower them down.

The ''[[Queen of Empire]]'' had transfer tubes onboard. [[Reck Desh]] forced [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to walk into a deactivated drop shaft, but as Solo did so he grabbed [[Droma]]'s tail, and pulled himself back up when Desh and the [[Peace Brigade]] were gone.
